selected.prompt: Edit image 1 to ROTATE THE SAME LIGHT GUARDIAN 90 degrees into a strict SIDE PROFILE FACING SCREEN RIGHT for a 2D fighting game. The first result is too frontal. Image 2 is the original Book of Memories native reference for identity. Keep the same pale broad cracked shell, luminous chest core, small red hanging cloth, very narrow legs, one thin claw arm and one huge segmented mace arm. Turn the entire torso and shell so the chest points to the RIGHT edge; the luminous core should be barely seen on the right edge of the chest rather than centered toward camera. The two shoulders overlap in profile; the near huge arm partly overlaps the torso and extends forward to the right, the far slim arm is mostly behind. Both knees and toes point right. Keep the complete silhouette, shell top, both feet and whole mace with 8% clear margin. Do not simply turn the feet while retaining a frontal chest. Do not add human head, face, armor ornaments, limbs or weapons. One single complete full body static idle, no scene, no floor, no text. Preserve transparent background and native alpha. No frontal presentation, no three-quarter front. Camera side-on at chest height, orthographic game sprite.

selected.review: Corps latéral orienté à droite, couronne florale entière, veste et cordons sombres, deux extrémités de manches et deux appuis liés à des montants de bois entièrement visibles. Aucun visage humain ni accessoire ajouté.
selected.limits: Vues natives frontales corroborées par les photos de la figurine officielle supervisée par Ito pour le revers et les montants. La figurine n'est pas un mesh extrait du jeu ; pose et détails floraux restent reconstruits. Le concept à baskets a été consulté puis exclu car il diffère de la version finale. Marges demandées 10% non acquises ; conserver les bornes mesurées. One static drawing. Native generated pixels unchanged; no resize, crop, alpha painting or other pixel processing. Very low alpha noise can extend beyond readable bounds.
selected.usageRestriction: Sakura Head remains a scripted pursuer outside autonomous duels. This new lateral presentation frame must not enable combat.
selected.prompt: One full-body transparent game sprite of SAKURA HEAD from SILENT HILL: The Short Message (2024). Images 1 and 2 are the final creature in the game, authoritative for appearance and proportions. Images 3 and 4 are the officially licensed Masahiro Ito-supervised statue, supplemental evidence for the back, twig bindings and complete lower leg/wooden post details; do NOT reproduce the display base, fence, labels, logo or scenic support. Faithfully retain the final design: a tall extended faceless head entirely covered in dense pale pink-white cherry blossoms around a dark forked wooden framework; off-white oversized jacket with puffed sleeves and black cord bindings around head, torso, forearms; a continuous blossom fringe down the front and around the lower hem; slim pale bare knees and long lower legs wrapped with dark cords and attached narrow wooden slats/posts, clustered flowers around the feet; short dark twig tips at the sleeve ends. No human face, eyes, mouth or added weapon. Repose the complete creature in a TRUE STRICT SIDE PROFILE FACING SCREEN RIGHT, shoulders and hips side-on, head tilted slightly toward an unseen opponent on the right. Arms hang down slightly forward in a quiet stalking idle, both bound leg/foot ends fully shown and slightly staggered. Keep source stature, not chibi, not a new outfit. Do not use the unused short flower-head concept with sneakers. Every flower crown tip, both sleeve/twig ends and both leg posts must fit with 10% empty transparent margin on all sides. One character, realistic clean detailed 2D combat sprite, neutral lighting, true transparent alpha background, no environment, ground, shadow cloud, floating petals or UI. One static full-body image, no animation sheet.
